1	#!/usr/bin/env bash
     2	# =============================================================================
     3	# pipeline-run.sh — the cycle-130 ablation pipeline executor (SDD §1.4 D-4.1 … D-4.10, §5.6)
     4	#
     5	# Runs ONE task under ONE arm: materialises a sandbox repository (the task's
     6	# fixture tree, or the review-catch PR under pr/, plus the Loa mount from the
     7	# pinned --source-tree), then drives Loa's phases as separate `claude -p`
     8	# sessions inside it, records every phase, enforces the per-run cap and writes
     9	# meta/pipeline.json. One executor serves every task type (D-4.1):
    10	#   review-catch                      REVIEW → AUDIT
    11	#   bug-fix | refactor | feature-build PLAN → IMPLEMENT → REVIEW → FIX? → AUDIT → FIX?
    12	# A FIX runs only when the gate before it wrote a CHANGES_REQUIRED LOA-VERDICT
    13	# trailer (the last `<!-- LOA-VERDICT {…} -->` line of
    14	# grimoires/loa/a2a/sprint-1/engineer-feedback.md resp. auditor-sprint-feedback.md);
    15	# a FIX that does not run is recorded `skipped: true`.
    16	# Arms edit the phase set (D-4.2): `sprint_plan: false` drops PLAN; `gates: false`
    17	# ends after IMPLEMENT; `loa_mount: false` runs one BARE session (no mount);
    18	# `flatline: false` keeps PLAN with the Flatline step off; `context_resets: false`
    19	# runs PLAN, IMPLEMENT and FIX as ONE implementer session (`--resume <session_id>`
    20	# from the first session's system/init event) while REVIEW and AUDIT stay separate.
    21	# The suite's `phase_sets[<review-catch|build>]` and an arm's `phases` override the
    22	# default phase list; the toggle edits above apply on top.
    23	#
    24	# Usage:
    25	#   pipeline-run.sh --task-yaml F --arm ID --run-dir D --run-id R --trial N \
    26	#                   --source-tree DIR --suite-file F [--max-run-usd 12] \
    27	#                   [--executor container|host] [--image IMG] [--claude-bin B] \
    28	#                   [--docker-bin D] [--phase-models JSON] [--phase-timeouts JSON] [--dry-run]
    29	#
    30	# Options:
    31	#   --task-yaml F       task.yaml (SDD §3.2); its directory holds TASK.md
    32	#   --arm ID            arm id declared in the suite file (`arms[].id`)
    33	#   --run-dir D         run directory to create (must not exist or be empty);
    34	#                       alias --workspace
    35	#   --run-id R          run id recorded in pipeline.json
    36	#   --trial N           trial number
    37	#   --source-tree DIR   the pinned Loa tree the mount is copied from
    38	#   --suite-file F      evals/suites/ablation-2.0.yaml (read with yq -o=json)
    39	#   --max-run-usd USD   per-run cap (default 12; config evals.ablation.run_cap_usd)
    40	#   --executor MODE     container (default; DEC-0411) or host
    41	#   --image IMG         container image (default loa-ablation:258)
    42	#   --claude-bin B      host-mode CLI (default $EVAL_CLAUDE_BIN, else claude)
    43	#   --docker-bin D      docker CLI (default $EVAL_DOCKER_BIN, else docker)
    44	#   --phase-models JSON {"PLAN": "<model id>", …} override ($LOA_EVAL_PHASE_MODELS)
    45	#   --phase-timeouts JSON {"IMPLEMENT": <seconds>, …} override
    46	#   --dry-run           print the phase plan and exit 0; nothing is created. Lines:
    47	#                       `plan: task … arm … phases <labels>`, one `phase <n> <label> model=…
    48	#                       max_turns=… timeout_s=… effort=… session=…` per phase, `sandbox:
    49	#                       mount=loa|none overlay=head|base|none(<why>) config_variant=eval|none
    50	#                       config_edits=<key=value,…>|-` (the arm's sandbox .loa.config.yaml edits),
    51	#                       and `eval_only: true (…)` for an eval_only arm
    52	#
    53	# Run directory layout (DEC-0413 — the grader never reads meta/):
    54	#   sandbox/     the agent's tree (its own .git initialised at `base`)
    55	#   snapshots/   <label>.bundle + index.json ({IMPLEMENT|FIX1|FIX2: commit}) after
    56	#                IMPLEMENT and each FIX
    57	#   transcripts/ events-<label>.jsonl (stream-json), stderr-<label>.log
    58	#   eval/        model-invoke.jsonl, cost-ledger.jsonl (copied out of
    59	#                sandbox/.eval/ after every phase), adversarial-{review,audit}.json:
    60	#                the gate envelopes, copied once when the gate ends (REVIEW → review,
    61	#                AUDIT → audit; never overwritten, a symlinked envelope is not copied;
    62	#                the phase record carries envelope_copied and envelope_sha256, the
    63	#                eval/ copy's sha256 or null). Later phases cannot rewrite them (audit MEDIUM-A1).
    64	#   meta/        pipeline.json, phase-<label>.argv.json (argv + captured env),
    65	#                prompt-<label>.md, arm, arm-evidence.txt, arm-env, refused.json,
    66	#                home/ (container mode: the per-run HOME; deleted at exit)
    67	#
    68	# Session (D-4.3, DEC-0394 as amended, DEC-0412): `claude -p <prompt> --output-format
    69	# stream-json --verbose --model <id> --permission-mode bypassPermissions
    70	# --dangerously-skip-permissions --setting-sources project --tools <list>
    71	# --max-turns <cap> [--effort <v>] [--resume <id>]`, cwd sandbox/, with exactly this
    72	# environment: PATH HOME LANG LC_ALL TERM TMPDIR CLAUDE_CODE_USE_BEDROCK
    73	# CLAUDE_CODE_SUBAGENT_MODEL LOA_MODELINV_LOG_PATH LOA_COST_LEDGER_PATH
    74	# GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL=/dev/null GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM=1 GH_CONFIG_DIR=<sandbox/.eval/gh-empty>,
    75	# the Bedrock route's pass-through keys when set in the driver's environment
    76	# (AWS_REGION AWS_DEFAULT_REGION AWS_PROFILE AWS_BEARER_TOKEN_BEDROCK
    77	# ANTHROPIC_BEDROCK_REGION_PREFIX ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_{OPUS,SONNET,HAIKU}_MODEL), and the
    78	# arm's LOA_* variables (LOA_ADVERSARIAL_REVIEW_ENFORCE=false for gates: false).
    79	# A python3 -I exec shim closes every descriptor above 2 and keeps exactly those keys;
    80	# values reach it through the environment, never argv, so AWS_BEARER_TOKEN_BEDROCK
    81	# appears in no argv, capture or log (phase-<label>.argv.json records it as "<set>").
    82	# `timeout --signal=TERM --kill-after=15` bounds the CLI.
    83	# Container mode (D-4.9, DEC-0411 as amended) runs the same command inside
    84	#   docker run --rm --name <n> --user <uid>:<gid> --network bridge --read-only
    85	#     --tmpfs /tmp:rw,size=1g --pids-limit 512 --memory 4g --cpus 2
    86	#     -v <run>/sandbox:/workspace:rw -v <run>/meta/home:/home/evaluser:rw
    87	#     -w /workspace -e <KEY=value…> -e AWS_BEARER_TOKEN_BEDROCK <image> python3 -I -c <shim> … claude …
    88	# Exactly two mounts. meta/home/ (mode 0700) holds a copy of $HOME/.codex/config.toml and
    89	# a copy of $HOME/.codex/auth.json whose tokens.refresh_token is the placeholder
    90	# "loa-ablation-no-refresh-token" (mode 0600; the real one is single-use and a container
    91	# refresh burned the host's; the codex CLI treats a MISSING key as logged out, KF-048)
    92	# when present, and empty .claude/ and .aws/; the CLI's session store
    93	# lives there for the whole run, so A6's --resume works across phases. No ~/.claude
    94	# file is ever copied. The directory is deleted at exit and on interrupt.
    95	# image_digest = the image's RepoDigest or id (container), else the fingerprint (host).
    96	# Versions: `fingerprint` is computed from the HOST toolchain; in container mode the
    97	# toolchain that runs the phases is the image's (Claude Code 2.1.299, codex 0.162.1 by
    98	# Dockerfile.ablation), so image_digest identifies the batch's versions. On 2026-10-15
    99	# the host CLI was 2.1.300 while the image pins 2.1.299; every arm runs in the container.
   100	#
   101	# Cap and watchdog (D-4.6, D-4.10): while a phase runs the driver re-prices the
   102	# stream's assistant-turn usage every $LOA_EVAL_WATCHDOG_POLL_S seconds (default 1)
   103	# from per-token prices fetched once per model (pricing.py; $LOA_EVAL_PRICING_JSON
   104	# overrides) and SIGTERMs the phase when spent + estimate ≥ the cap (cap_turn
   105	# recorded). After each phase the result's total_cost_usd (authoritative) plus the
   106	# sandbox cost-ledger rows written during the phase are added; ≥ cap → cap_failure.
   107	#
   108	# Exit codes:
   109	#   0  finished (any verdict)                                   status completed
   110	#   1  agent error: a phase exited non-zero or timed out        status agent_error
   111	#   2  infrastructure: usage, refused arm/type, mount/toggle failure, CLI/docker
   112	#      or image missing, fixture path rule, leak guard          status infrastructure_error
   113	#   3  cap failure (run stopped at the cap)                     status cap_failure
   114	#   4  interrupted (SIGTERM/SIGINT/SIGHUP to the driver, or a phase killed from
   115	#      outside)                                                 status interrupted
   116	# pipeline.json is written for every exit except usage errors and --dry-run; it is
   117	# rewritten with status `running` after each phase so a SIGKILLed driver leaves a
   118	# record (ablation-row.sh reads `running` as interrupted).
   119	# Closed mount (cycle-131 FR-1, SDD §5.2, DEC-0613/DEC-0622): for a review-catch task with
   120	# the Loa mount, every answer-bearing path of the PR fixture under .claude/ is overlaid with
   121	# the PR's own version (lib overlay_answer_paths; mode from task.yaml

1	#!/usr/bin/env bash
     2	# =============================================================================
     3	# pipeline-run.sh — the cycle-130 ablation pipeline executor (SDD §1.4 D-4.1 … D-4.10, §5.6)
     4	#
     5	# Runs ONE task under ONE arm: materialises a sandbox repository (the task's
     6	# fixture tree, or the review-catch PR under pr/, plus the Loa mount from the
     7	# pinned --source-tree), then drives Loa's phases as separate `claude -p`
     8	# sessions inside it, records every phase, enforces the per-run cap and writes
     9	# meta/pipeline.json. One executor serves every task type (D-4.1):
    10	#   review-catch                      REVIEW → AUDIT
    11	#   bug-fix | refactor | feature-build PLAN → IMPLEMENT → REVIEW → FIX? → AUDIT → FIX?
    12	# A FIX runs only when the gate before it wrote a CHANGES_REQUIRED LOA-VERDICT
    13	# trailer (the last `<!-- LOA-VERDICT {…} -->` line of
    14	# grimoires/loa/a2a/sprint-1/engineer-feedback.md resp. auditor-sprint-feedback.md);
    15	# a FIX that does not run is recorded `skipped: true`.
    16	# Arms edit the phase set (D-4.2): `sprint_plan: false` drops PLAN; `gates: false`
    17	# ends after IMPLEMENT; `loa_mount: false` runs one BARE session (no mount);
    18	# `flatline: false` keeps PLAN with the Flatline step off; `context_resets: false`
    19	# runs PLAN, IMPLEMENT and FIX as ONE implementer session (`--resume <session_id>`
    20	# from the first session's system/init event) while REVIEW and AUDIT stay separate.
    21	# The suite's `phase_sets[<review-catch|build>]` and an arm's `phases` override the
    22	# default phase list; the toggle edits above apply on top.
    23	#
    24	# Usage:
    25	#   pipeline-run.sh --task-yaml F --arm ID --run-dir D --run-id R --trial N \
    26	#                   --source-tree DIR --suite-file F [--max-run-usd 12] \
    27	#                   [--executor container|host] [--image IMG] [--claude-bin B] \
    28	#                   [--docker-bin D] [--phase-models JSON] [--phase-timeouts JSON] [--dry-run]
    29	#
    30	# Options:
    31	#   --task-yaml F       task.yaml (SDD §3.2); its directory holds TASK.md
    32	#   --arm ID            arm id declared in the suite file (`arms[].id`)
    33	#   --run-dir D         run directory to create (must not exist or be empty);
    34	#                       alias --workspace
    35	#   --run-id R          run id recorded in pipeline.json
    36	#   --trial N           trial number
    37	#   --source-tree DIR   the pinned Loa tree the mount is copied from
    38	#   --suite-file F      evals/suites/ablation-2.0.yaml (read with yq -o=json)
    39	#   --max-run-usd USD   per-run cap (default 12; config evals.ablation.run_cap_usd)
    40	#   --executor MODE     container (default; DEC-0411) or host
    41	#   --image IMG         container image (default loa-ablation:258)
    42	#   --claude-bin B      host-mode CLI (default $EVAL_CLAUDE_BIN, else claude)
    43	#   --docker-bin D      docker CLI (default $EVAL_DOCKER_BIN, else docker)
    44	#   --phase-models JSON {"PLAN": "<model id>", …} override ($LOA_EVAL_PHASE_MODELS)
    45	#   --phase-timeouts JSON {"IMPLEMENT": <seconds>, …} override
    46	#   --dry-run           print the phase plan and exit 0; nothing is created. Lines:
    47	#                       `plan: task … arm … phases <labels>`, one `phase <n> <label> model=…
    48	#                       max_turns=… timeout_s=… effort=… session=…` per phase, `sandbox:
    49	#                       mount=loa|none overlay=head|base|none(<why>) config_variant=eval|none
    50	#                       config_edits=<key=value,…>|-` (the arm's sandbox .loa.config.yaml edits),
    51	#                       and `eval_only: true (…)` for an eval_only arm
    52	#
    53	# Run directory layout (DEC-0413 — the grader never reads meta/):
    54	#   sandbox/     the agent's tree (its own .git initialised at `base`)
    55	#   snapshots/   <label>.bundle + index.json ({IMPLEMENT|FIX1|FIX2: commit}) after
    56	#                IMPLEMENT and each FIX
    57	#   transcripts/ events-<label>.jsonl (stream-json), stderr-<label>.log
    58	#   eval/        model-invoke.jsonl, cost-ledger.jsonl (copied out of
    59	#                sandbox/.eval/ after every phase), adversarial-{review,audit}.json:
    60	#                the gate envelopes, copied once when the gate ends (REVIEW → review,
    61	#                AUDIT → audit; never overwritten, a symlinked envelope is not copied;
    62	#                the phase record carries envelope_copied and envelope_sha256, the
    63	#                eval/ copy's sha256 or null). Later phases cannot rewrite them (audit MEDIUM-A1).
    64	#   meta/        pipeline.json, phase-<label>.argv.json (argv + captured env),
    65	#                prompt-<label>.md, arm, arm-evidence.txt, arm-env, refused.json,
    66	#                home/ (container mode: the per-run HOME; deleted at exit)
    67	#
    68	# Session (D-4.3, DEC-0394 as amended, DEC-0412): `claude -p <prompt> --output-format
    69	# stream-json --verbose --model <id> --permission-mode bypassPermissions
    70	# --dangerously-skip-permissions --setting-sources project --tools <list>
    71	# --max-turns <cap> [--effort <v>] [--resume <id>]`, cwd sandbox/, with exactly this
    72	# environment: PATH HOME LANG LC_ALL TERM TMPDIR CLAUDE_CODE_USE_BEDROCK
    73	# CLAUDE_CODE_SUBAGENT_MODEL LOA_MODELINV_LOG_PATH LOA_COST_LEDGER_PATH
    74	# GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL=/dev/null GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM=1 GH_CONFIG_DIR=<sandbox/.eval/gh-empty>,
    75	# the Bedrock route's pass-through keys when set in the driver's environment
    76	# (AWS_REGION AWS_DEFAULT_REGION AWS_PROFILE AWS_BEARER_TOKEN_BEDROCK
    77	# ANTHROPIC_BEDROCK_REGION_PREFIX ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_{OPUS,SONNET,HAIKU}_MODEL), and the
    78	# arm's LOA_* variables (LOA_ADVERSARIAL_REVIEW_ENFORCE=false for gates: false).
    79	# A python3 -I exec shim closes every descriptor above 2 and keeps exactly those keys;
    80	# values reach it through the environment, never argv, so AWS_BEARER_TOKEN_BEDROCK
    81	# appears in no argv, capture or log (phase-<label>.argv.json records it as "<set>").
    82	# `timeout --signal=TERM --kill-after=15` bounds the CLI.
    83	# Container mode (D-4.9, DEC-0411 as amended) runs the same command inside
    84	#   docker run --rm --name <n> --user <uid>:<gid> --network bridge --read-only
    85	#     --tmpfs /tmp:rw,size=1g --pids-limit 512 --memory 4g --cpus 2
    86	#     -v <run>/sandbox:/workspace:rw -v <run>/meta/home:/home/evaluser:rw
    87	#     -w /workspace -e <KEY=value…> -e AWS_BEARER_TOKEN_BEDROCK <image> python3 -I -c <shim> … claude …
    88	# Exactly two mounts. meta/home/ (mode 0700) holds a copy of $HOME/.codex/config.toml and
    89	# a copy of $HOME/.codex/auth.json whose tokens.refresh_token is the placeholder
    90	# "loa-ablation-no-refresh-token" (mode 0600; the real one is single-use and a container
    91	# refresh burned the host's; the codex CLI treats a MISSING key as logged out, KF-048)
    92	# when present, and empty .claude/ and .aws/; the CLI's session store
    93	# lives there for the whole run, so A6's --resume works across phases. No ~/.claude
    94	# file is ever copied. The directory is deleted at exit and on interrupt.
    95	# image_digest = the image's RepoDigest or id (container), else the fingerprint (host).
    96	# Versions: `fingerprint` is computed from the HOST toolchain; in container mode the
    97	# toolchain that runs the phases is the image's (Claude Code 2.1.299, codex 0.162.1 by
    98	# Dockerfile.ablation), so image_digest identifies the batch's versions. On 2026-10-15
    99	# the host CLI was 2.1.300 while the image pins 2.1.299; every arm runs in the container.
   100	#
   101	# Cap and watchdog (D-4.6, D-4.10): while a phase runs the driver re-prices the
   102	# stream's assistant-turn usage every $LOA_EVAL_WATCHDOG_POLL_S seconds (default 1)
   103	# from per-token prices fetched once per model (pricing.py; $LOA_EVAL_PRICING_JSON
   104	# overrides) and SIGTERMs the phase when spent + estimate ≥ the cap (cap_turn
   105	# recorded). After each phase the result's total_cost_usd (authoritative) plus the
   106	# sandbox cost-ledger rows written during the phase are added; ≥ cap → cap_failure.
   107	#
   108	# Exit codes:
   109	#   0  finished (any verdict)                                   status completed
   110	#   1  agent error: a phase exited non-zero or timed out        status agent_error
   111	#   2  infrastructure: usage, refused arm/type, mount/toggle failure, CLI/docker
   112	#      or image missing, fixture path rule, leak guard          status infrastructure_error
   113	#   3  cap failure (run stopped at the cap)                     status cap_failure
   114	#   4  interrupted (SIGTERM/SIGINT/SIGHUP to the driver, or a phase killed from
   115	#      outside)                                                 status interrupted
   116	# pipeline.json is written for every exit except usage errors and --dry-run; it is
   117	# rewritten with status `running` after each phase so a SIGKILLed driver leaves a
   118	# record (ablation-row.sh reads `running` as interrupted).
   119	# Closed mount (cycle-131 FR-1, SDD §5.2, DEC-0613/DEC-0622): for a review-catch task with
   120	# the Loa mount, every answer-bearing path of the PR fixture under .claude/ is overlaid with
   121	# the PR's own version (lib overlay_answer_paths; mode from task.yaml
   122	# review_catch.overlay_mode, head by default, base the per-task fallback) right after
   123	# mount_prompt_surface; copy_source (the source tree's HEAD) must equal source_commit, else
   124	# the trial is refused (infrastructure_error). Order: mount_prompt_surface → overlay_answer_paths
   125	# → apply_arm_toggles → apply_eval_config_variant → write_sandbox_grimoire → init_sandbox_beads
   126	# → regen_sandbox_manifest → check_mount_closed (clauses (a)-(d) of took-effect.sh
   127	# oracle_closed on the surface about to launch; a failure is infrastructure_error naming
   128	# the clause and path, and no phase runs). An arm whose toggles set oracle_open: true (the
   129	# eval-only open-mount arm) skips the overlay and the check and records mount_overlay=none.
   130	# Every mounted arm runs the cycle-131 eval config variant (both gates' budget_scale: diff,
   131	# budget_cents_max 600; evidence config_variant=eval). Toggle bare_model: fable runs the BARE
   132	# phase on global.anthropic.claude-fable-5-1 (it wins over --phase-models and the suite's
   133	# phase_defaults for BARE). All evidence reaches meta/arm-evidence.txt before the first phase.
   134	# Mount integrity (audit LOW-A2): after materialisation the sha256 of sandbox/CLAUDE.md
   135	# and sandbox/.loa.config.yaml go to arm_evidence (claude_md_sha256, loa_config_sha256 =
   136	# <hex>|absent); at finish both are recomputed into pipeline.json.mount_integrity =
   137	# {claude_md, loa_config} each ok|changed|absent (loa_mount: false → both absent; null
   138	# when the run stopped before materialisation). `.claude/` itself is covered by
   139	# took-effect.sh integrity_clean.
   140	#
   141	# eval_only arms (cycle-131 FR-5): an arm declaring `eval_only: true` (a1_full_openmount) is
   142	# refused — exit 2, `refused: arm '<id>': eval_only arm outside an evaluation batch`, before the
   143	# run directory exists, so no pipeline.json and no infrastructure_error is ever written — unless
   144	# LOA_ABLATION_BATCH_CONTEXT=1 (exactly 1). run-ablation.sh exports it to every trial it launches
   145	# (batch and smoke); --dry-run honours the same variable, so the operator dry-runs the
   146	# open-mount arm with `LOA_ABLATION_BATCH_CONTEXT=1 pipeline-run.sh … --dry-run`.
   147	#
   148	# Env: EVAL_CLAUDE_BIN, EVAL_DOCKER_BIN, LOA_EVAL_PHASE_MODELS, LOA_EVAL_PRICING_JSON,
   149	# LOA_EVAL_WATCHDOG_POLL_S, LOA_EVAL_CREDS_HOME (where ~/.codex is read; default $HOME),
   150	# LOA_EVAL_CONTAINER_CLAUDE_BIN (default claude), LOA_EVAL_EXECUTOR, LOA_ABLATION_BATCH_CONTEXT.
   151	#
   152	# Mount library: lib/sandbox-mount.sh beside this script, sourced by a literal path.
   153	# Exported to it: ARM_EVIDENCE_FILE, ARM_ENV_FILE (meta/arm-env), LOA_EVAL_SUITE_FILE.
   154	#
   155	# Tested by evals/tests/pipeline-run.bats (stub claude, stub docker, and a temporary
   156	# copy of this harness whose lib/sandbox-mount.sh is the stub mount library).

   242	ARM_DEF="$(jq -c --arg a "$ARM" '[.arms // [] | .[] | select(.id == $a)][0] // empty' <<<"$SUITE_JSON")"

   264	# plan_phases <toggles-json> → JSON array of {name,label}
   265	plan_phases() {
   266	  jq -c -n --argjson arm "$ARM_DEF" --argjson suite "$SUITE_JSON" --argjson tg "$1" --arg kind "$KIND" '
   267	    ( if $kind == "review-catch" then ["REVIEW","AUDIT"] else ["PLAN","IMPLEMENT","REVIEW","FIX","AUDIT","FIX"] end ) as $dflt
   268	    | ( $arm.phases // $suite.phase_sets[$kind] // $dflt ) as $p0
   269	    | ( if ($tg.loa_mount == false) then ["BARE"] else $p0 end ) as $p1
   270	    | ( if ($tg.sprint_plan == false) then ($p1 | map(select(. != "PLAN"))) else $p1 end ) as $p2
   271	    | ( if ($tg.gates == false) and ($p2 | index("IMPLEMENT")) != null
   272	          then $p2[0:(($p2 | index("IMPLEMENT")) + 1)] else $p2 end ) as $p3
   273	    | reduce $p3[] as $n ({out: [], fix: 0};
   274	        if $n == "FIX" then .fix += 1 | .out += [{name: "FIX", label: ("FIX" + (.fix | tostring))}]
   275	        else .out += [{name: $n, label: $n}] end)
   276	    | .out'
   277	}

   285	builtin_model() { case "$1" in REVIEW|AUDIT) echo global.anthropic.claude-fable-5-1 ;; *) echo global.anthropic.claude-opus-5-5 ;; esac; }
   286	builtin_turns() { case "$1" in PLAN) echo 30 ;; IMPLEMENT) echo 60 ;; REVIEW|FIX|AUDIT) echo 40 ;; BARE) echo 170 ;; *) echo 40 ;; esac; }
   287	builtin_tmin()  { case "$1" in PLAN) echo 15 ;; IMPLEMENT) echo 25 ;; REVIEW|AUDIT) echo 20 ;; FIX) echo 15 ;; BARE) echo 70 ;; *) echo 20 ;; esac; }
   288	
   289	BARE_FABLE_MODEL="global.anthropic.claude-fable-5-1"
   290	BARE_MODEL_TOGGLE="$(jq -r '.bare_model // empty' <<<"$SUITE_TOGGLES")"   # re-read from the library's toggles below
   291	phase_model() {  # bare_model: fable (cycle-131 D-5.1) decides BARE over every other source
   292	  if [[ "$1" == BARE && "$BARE_MODEL_TOGGLE" == fable ]]; then printf '%s\n' "$BARE_FABLE_MODEL"; return 0; fi
   293	  jq -r --arg n "$1" --arg d "$(builtin_model "$1")" --argjson o "$PHASE_MODELS_JSON" \
   294	    '$o[$n] // .phase_defaults.models[$n] // $d' <<<"$SUITE_JSON"
   295	}
   296	phase_cap() {  # phase_cap <name> max_turns|timeout_min — task bounds > suite phase_defaults > built-in;
   297	               # BARE without a declaration = PLAN + IMPLEMENT + 2 × FIX
   298	  local n="$1" key="$2" v
   299	  v="$(jq -r --arg n "$n" --arg k "$key" '.bounds[$k][$n] // empty' <<<"$TASK_JSON")"
   300	  [[ -n "$v" ]] || v="$(jq -r --arg n "$n" --arg k "$key" '.phase_defaults[$k][$n] // empty' <<<"$SUITE_JSON")"
   301	  if [[ -z "$v" && "$n" == "BARE" ]]; then
   302	    v=$(( $(phase_cap PLAN "$key") + $(phase_cap IMPLEMENT "$key") + 2 * $(phase_cap FIX "$key") ))
   303	  fi

#                   [--pipeline-bin P] [--grade-bin G] [--row-bin R] [--took-effect-bin T]
#                   [--docker-bin D]
#
# Options:
#   --arms CSV           arm ids in the order given (default: the suite's priority minus
#                        every arm declared absent: true); each must be declared
#   --source-commit SHA  the Loa commit the arms run (the pinned source tree)
#   --tasks CSV          task ids (default: every <suite-root>/tasks/<id>/task.yaml;
#                        --smoke: every smoke/<id>/)
#   --types CSV          keep tasks of these types (feature-build, bug-fix, refactor,
#                        review-catch; `build` = the three build types)
#   --trials-build N     trials per build task (default the suite's trials.build; --smoke 1)
#   --trials-review N    trials per review-catch task (default trials.review-catch; --smoke 1)
#   --max-usd USD        batch spend cap (see Spend); no cap when absent
#   --run-cap USD        the single-cap override: one per-run cap for both task kinds (see
#                        Run caps). Without it each kind takes the suite's
#                        caps.run_usd_by_type[<kind>], else evals.ablation.run_cap_usd in
#                        .loa.config.yaml, else the suite's caps.run_usd, else 12. Ignored
#                        (with a stderr note) on --resume: a batch keeps its MANIFEST caps
#   --concurrency N      trials at once, 1-9 (default 3)
#   --batch NAME         batch directory name (default batch-<UTC ts>; --smoke smoke-<UTC ts>;
#                        the smoke- prefix is reserved for --smoke)
#   --results-root DIR   where batch directories live (default

#   --rows F             the rows file (default: --smoke <batch>/rows.jsonl; otherwise
#                        grimoires/loa/reports/ablation-2.0/runs.jsonl, the tracked file, or
#                        <results-root>/runs.jsonl when --results-root is given). A smoke
#                        batch never writes the tracked file (DEC-0428: smoke rows decide nothing)
#   --suite-root DIR     suite root (default grimoires/loa/evals/ablation-2.0)
#   --suite-file F       suite file (default evals/suites/ablation-2.0.yaml)
#   --image IMG          container image (default loa-ablation:258)
#   --executor MODE      container (default) or host; passed to pipeline-run.sh and the grader

#   --pre-registration-ref TEXT  the NOTES pre-registration heading and timestamp (MANIFEST)
#   --seed N             shuffle seed (default 20261015)
#   --self-check-log F   the recorded image self-check (default

if [[ -z "$RUN_CAP" ]]; then

  usd_ok "${RUN_CAP:-x}" || RUN_CAP="$(jq -r '.caps.run_usd // ""' <<<"$SUITE_JSON")"
  usd_ok "${RUN_CAP:-x}" || RUN_CAP=12
fi
# per-kind caps (DEC-0567): --run-cap, else the suite's caps.run_usd_by_type[<kind>], else
# RUN_CAP from the chain above (.loa.config.yaml evals.ablation.run_cap_usd, else
# caps.run_usd, else 12). A present but malformed per-kind entry is refused, never skipped.
suite_kind_cap() {  # suite_kind_cap <kind> → the suite's entry, or empty when it has none
  local v
  v="$(jq -r --arg k "$1" '.caps.run_usd_by_type // null
        | if . == null then "" elif type == "object" then (.[$k] // "" | tostring) else "!" end' <<<"$SUITE_JSON")"
  [[ "$v" != "!" ]] || die "suite caps.run_usd_by_type must be a map of task kind to USD ($SUITE_FILE)"
  [[ -z "$v" ]] || usd_ok "$v" || die "suite caps.run_usd_by_type.$1 is not an amount in USD: $v ($SUITE_FILE)"
  printf '%s' "$v"
}

    CAP_REVIEW="$(suite_kind_cap review-catch)" || exit 2; CAP_REVIEW="${CAP_REVIEW:-$RUN_CAP}"
  fi

hint_for() { local h; h="$(jq -r --arg k "$1" '.cost_hint | if type == "object" then .[$k] // "" else (. // "") end' <<<"$SUITE_JSON")"; usd_ok "${h:-x}" || h=5.0; printf '%s' "$h"; }

est_hint() { if [[ "${1#*|}" == review-catch ]]; then printf '%s' "$HINT_REVIEW"; else printf '%s' "$HINT_BUILD"; fi; }

[[ ${#ALL_TASKS[@]} -gt 0 ]] || die "no tasks under $TDIR"
SEL_TASKS=()

  for t in "${SEL_TASKS[@]}"; do

else

fi

#
# Options:
#   --arms CSV           arm ids in the order given (default: the suite's priority minus
#                        every arm declared absent: true); each must be declared
#   --source-commit SHA  the Loa commit the arms run (the pinned source tree)
#   --tasks CSV          task ids (default: every <suite-root>/tasks/<id>/task.yaml;

#   --trials-review N    trials per review-catch task (default trials.review-catch; --smoke 1)
#   --max-usd USD        batch spend cap (see Spend); no cap when absent
#   --run-cap USD        the single-cap override: one per-run cap for both task kinds (see
#                        Run caps). Without it each kind takes the suite's
#                        caps.run_usd_by_type[<kind>], else evals.ablation.run_cap_usd in
#                        .loa.config.yaml, else the suite's caps.run_usd, else 12. Ignored
#                        (with a stderr note) on --resume: a batch keeps its MANIFEST caps
#   --concurrency N      trials at once, 1-9 (default 3)
#   --batch NAME         batch directory name (default batch-<UTC ts>; --smoke smoke-<UTC ts>;
#                        the smoke- prefix is reserved for --smoke)
#   --results-root DIR   where batch directories live (default
#                        grimoires/loa/reports/ablation-2.0/batches; --smoke

#   --rows F             the rows file (default: --smoke <batch>/rows.jsonl; otherwise
#                        grimoires/loa/reports/ablation-2.0/runs.jsonl, the tracked file, or
#                        <results-root>/runs.jsonl when --results-root is given). A smoke
#                        batch never writes the tracked file (DEC-0428: smoke rows decide nothing)
#   --suite-root DIR     suite root (default grimoires/loa/evals/ablation-2.0)
#   --suite-file F       suite file (default evals/suites/ablation-2.0.yaml)
#   --image IMG          container image (default loa-ablation:258)
#   --executor MODE      container (default) or host; passed to pipeline-run.sh and the grader
#                        (host grading needs LOA_EVAL_ALLOW_HOST_GRADING=1, see ablation-grade.sh)
#   --pre-registration-ref TEXT  the NOTES pre-registration heading and timestamp (MANIFEST)
#   --seed N             shuffle seed (default 20261015)
#   --self-check-log F   the recorded image self-check (default
#                        grimoires/loa/a2a/sprint-259/self-check-image.log)
#   --smoke              smoke batch: smoke/ tasks, one trial each, no hard gate, own rows
#   --dry-run            run the pre-flight, print the plan, write MANIFEST.json only
#                        (MANIFEST.dry-run.json when the batch already has a STATUS.json)
======
if [[ -z "$RUN_CAP" ]]; then
  RUN_CAP="$(yq -r '.evals.ablation.run_cap_usd // ""' "$REPO_ROOT/.loa.config.yaml" 2>/dev/null || true)"
  usd_ok "${RUN_CAP:-x}" || RUN_CAP="$(jq -r '.caps.run_usd // ""' <<<"$SUITE_JSON")"
  usd_ok "${RUN_CAP:-x}" || RUN_CAP=12
fi
# per-kind caps (DEC-0567): --run-cap, else the suite's caps.run_usd_by_type[<kind>], else
# RUN_CAP from the chain above (.loa.config.yaml evals.ablation.run_cap_usd, else
# caps.run_usd, else 12). A present but malformed per-kind entry is refused, never skipped.
suite_kind_cap() {  # suite_kind_cap <kind> → the suite's entry, or empty when it has none
  local v
  v="$(jq -r --arg k "$1" '.caps.run_usd_by_type // null
        | if . == null then "" elif type == "object" then (.[$k] // "" | tostring) else "!" end' <<<"$SUITE_JSON")"
  [[ "$v" != "!" ]] || die "suite caps.run_usd_by_type must be a map of task kind to USD ($SUITE_FILE)"
  [[ -z "$v" ]] || usd_ok "$v" || die "suite caps.run_usd_by_type.$1 is not an amount in USD: $v ($SUITE_FILE)"
  printf '%s' "$v"
}
if [[ -z "$CAP_BUILD" ]]; then   # --resume set both from MANIFEST.json
  if [[ -n "$RUN_CAP_OVERRIDE" ]]; then CAP_BUILD="$RUN_CAP_OVERRIDE" CAP_REVIEW="$RUN_CAP_OVERRIDE"
  else
    CAP_BUILD="$(suite_kind_cap build)" || exit 2; CAP_BUILD="${CAP_BUILD:-$RUN_CAP}"
    CAP_REVIEW="$(suite_kind_cap review-catch)" || exit 2; CAP_REVIEW="${CAP_REVIEW:-$RUN_CAP}"
  fi
fi
cap_for() { if [[ "$1" == review-catch ]]; then printf '%s' "$CAP_REVIEW"; else printf '%s' "$CAP_BUILD"; fi; }
hint_for() { local h; h="$(jq -r --arg k "$1" '.cost_hint | if type == "object" then .[$k] // "" else (. // "") end' <<<"$SUITE_JSON")"; usd_ok "${h:-x}" || h=5.0; printf '%s' "$h"; }
HINT_BUILD="$(hint_for build)" HINT_REVIEW="$(hint_for review-catch)"
# est_next's last fallback per kind (the key is "<arm>|<kind>")
est_hint() { if [[ "${1#*|}" == review-catch ]]; then printf '%s' "$HINT_REVIEW"; else printf '%s' "$HINT_BUILD"; fi; }

# --- arms and tasks -----------------------------------------------------------------------
[[ -n "$ARMS_CSV" ]] || ARMS_CSV="$(jq -r '(.arms // [] | map(select(.absent == true) | .id)) as $absent
                                            | [.priority // [] | .[] | select(IN($absent[]) | not)] | join(",")' <<<"$SUITE_JSON")"
IFS=',' read -r -a ARMS <<<"$ARMS_CSV"
[[ ${#ARMS[@]} -gt 0 && -n "${ARMS[0]}" ]] || die "no arms (--arms, or the suite's priority)"
for a in "${ARMS[@]}"; do
  [[ "$a" =~ ^[a-z][a-z0-9_]{0,63}$ ]] || die "invalid arm id '$a'"
  def="$(jq -c --arg a "$a" '[.arms // [] | .[] | select(.id == $a)][0] // empty' <<<"$SUITE_JSON")"
  [[ -n "$def" ]] || die "arm '$a' is not declared in $SUITE_FILE"
  [[ "$(jq -r '.absent // false' <<<"$def")" != true ]] || die "arm '$a' is declared absent: true"
done
[[ "$(printf '%s\n' "${ARMS[@]}" | sort | uniq -d)" == "" ]] || die "--arms lists an arm twice"

ALL_TASKS=()
while IFS= read -r d; do ALL_TASKS+=("$d"); done < <(cd "$TDIR" && for d in */; do d="${d%/}"; [[ -f "$d/task.yaml" ]] && printf '%s\n' "$d"; done | LC_ALL=C sort)
[[ ${#ALL_TASKS[@]} -gt 0 ]] || die "no tasks under $TDIR"
SEL_TASKS=()
if [[ -n "$TASKS_CSV" && "$RESUME" != true ]]; then
  IFS=',' read -r -a SEL_TASKS <<<"$TASKS_CSV"

    [[ -f "$TDIR/$t/task.yaml" ]] || die "task not found: $TDIR/$t/task.yaml"
  done
else
  SEL_TASKS=("${ALL_TASKS[@]}")
fi
WANT_TYPES=""
if [[ -n "$TYPES_CSV" ]]; then
  IFS=',' read -r -a tl <<<"$TYPES_CSV"

    case "$ty" in

1	# =============================================================================
     2	# evals/suites/ablation-2.0.yaml — cycle-130 Loa 2.0 component ablation suite
     3	#
     4	# SDD §3.3 (structure reproduced), extended by Sprint 258 Task 1.6: the
     5	# tasks block with the smoke root, phase_defaults, phase_sets, cost_hint, each
     6	# arm's phase-set override and took-effect rule ids, and the full pre-registered
     7	# rules block (D-A5; mirrored in NOTES before the first run, DEC-0383).
     8	#
     9	# Readers: execute-agent.sh / lib/sandbox-mount.sh (arms[].toggles via
    10	# resolve_arm_toggles), pipeline-run.sh (phase_defaults, phase_sets,
    11	# arms[].phases, arms[].effort), took-effect.sh (arms[].took_effect),
    12	# run-ablation.sh (trials, caps, priority, cut_ladder, arms[].task_types),
    13	# ablation-report.py (rules), validate-suite.sh (arm ids for the leakage check,
    14	# task_types against the known types).
    15	#
    16	# task_types: `all` | `build` (= feature-build, bug-fix, refactor) |
    17	#   `review-catch` | a single build type. An arm is never scheduled, and a row
    18	#   never reported, on a type outside its declaration (DEC-0400, DEC-0406).
    19	# took_effect: rule ids took-effect.sh evaluates per trial (DEC-0418); a miss is
    20	#   infrastructure_error and pauses the arm. `applicability_refused` is the
    21	#   smoke's evidence line that the planner refused the arm on a review-catch task.
    22	# toggles (the vocabulary apply_arm_toggles and pipeline-run.sh accept; every value is
    23	#   `false` except where named): companion_voice, karpathy_block, rule_files,
    24	#   audit_delta_instruction, loa_mount, gates, flatline, sprint_plan, context_resets,
    25	#   effort: low|medium|high|xhigh|max, and from cycle-131 (FR-5, DEC-0619)
    26	#   bare_model: fable (BARE on Fable 5.1), dissent: false (the review gate's
    27	#   adversarial dissent off in the sandbox config; the audit gate unchanged),
    28	#   oracle_open: true (eval-only: the closed-mount overlay skipped, mount_overlay=none).
    29	#   Every mounted review-catch arm runs the closed mount (lib/sandbox-mount.sh
    30	#   overlay_answer_paths, head mode unless the task sets review_catch.overlay_mode: base)
    31	#   and every mounted arm the eval config variant (config_variant=eval).
    32	# eval_only: true|false (cycle-131 FR-5; default false): an evaluation-only arm. pipeline-run.sh
    33	#   refuses it (exit 2) unless LOA_ABLATION_BATCH_CONTEXT=1, which run-ablation.sh exports to every
    34	#   trial it launches; validate-suite.sh requires it on an arm whose toggles set oracle_open: true.
    35	# =============================================================================

    37	version: 1

    47	# Per-run caps (DEC-0559, DEC-0567): from Sprint 261 the cap is per task kind,
    48	# run_usd_by_type {build: 15, review-catch: 20}; run-ablation.sh passes the kind's cap to
    49	# pipeline-run.sh --max-run-usd, charges a cap failure or a costless failed trial that
    50	# kind's cap, and reserves in-flight trials at the largest cap among the plan's kinds.
    51	# run_usd stays the single-cap fallback (suite v1 batches, a kind without an entry) and
    52	# --run-cap overrides both kinds. reserve_usd is kept for spend.sh; DEC-0559 released the
    53	# reserve (a batch's --max-usd = 1,500 - spend so far - concurrency x the largest cap).

    79	     took_effect: [no_dot_claude, no_system_prompt, no_audit_rows, integrity_clean]}

    84	  - {id: a3_one_voice, label: A3, task_types: [all], toggles: {companion_voice: false}, took_effect: [one_voice_planned, integrity_clean]}
    85	  - {id: a4_no_gates, label: A4, task_types: [build], toggles: {gates: false},
    86	     phases: [PLAN, IMPLEMENT],
    87	     took_effect: [no_gate_phases, enforce_env_false, applicability_refused, integrity_clean]}   # build only: on a review-catch task the gates are the task (DEC-0400)

    91	     took_effect: [implementer_single_session, gates_separate_sessions, applicability_refused, integrity_clean]}
    92	  - {id: a7_effort_medium, label: A7, task_types: [all], toggles: {effort: medium},
    93	     took_effect: [effort_flag_medium, skill_effort_stripped, integrity_clean]}
    94	  # cycle-131 FR-5 (DEC-0619, SDD §3.2 "Entity: suite arm"): review-catch only. a0_bare_fable is A0 on the
    95	  # review model; a1_review_only drops the AUDIT gate; a1_no_dissent turns the review gate's dissent off;
    96	  # a1_full_openmount is the cycle-130 open mount, eval_only (pipeline-run.sh refuses it outside a
    97	  # run-ablation.sh batch or smoke: LOA_ABLATION_BATCH_CONTEXT=1) and never a decision arm

5	#
6	# evals/harness/pipeline-run.sh drives Loa's phases as separate CLI sessions in a
7	# sandbox repository. Here the CLI is evals/tests/fixtures/claude-stub-pipeline.sh,
8	# docker is fixtures/docker-stub.sh, and the executor runs from a temporary copy of
9	# the harness (make_harness) whose lib/sandbox-mount.sh is fixtures/mount-lib-stub.sh:
10	# the shipped script sources its library by a literal path only (eval.yml trust
11	# boundary), so there is no environment override to point. The executor runs the CLI under
12	# `env -i`, which strips the stubs' control variables, so each test reaches the
13	# stubs through generated wrappers ($T/claude, $T/docker) that first record the
14	# environment and descriptors the executor gave them, then load $T/stub.env.
15	# =============================================================================

18	  TESTS_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "$BATS_TEST_FILENAME")" && pwd)"

Exclude it from components (treat it like BARE, e.g. an H1-style line) rather than counting it as a decision arm.

+head/evals/harness/ablation-report.py:2003 — Rows of the eval_only arm a1_full_openmount pass list_reason() (declared, not absent, applies to review-catch) and enter cells, but the arm is in neither `components` nor `detail_arms`, so its rows appear in no decision, no per-arm detail and not in "Rows listed, never decided". The open-mount oracle A/B evidence that FR-5 exists to produce vanishes from the report while still counting in the row totals. Either list them with a reason ("eval_only arm, never decided") or render a per-arm detail/A/B section for eval_only arms.

+head/evals/suites/ablation-2.0.yaml:55 — `priority` was not extended with a0_bare_fable, a1_review_only or a1_no_dissent, so a default batch (run-ablation.sh --arms unset = priority minus absent) never schedules the new decision arms, while ablation-report.py now emits a permanent "no rows" decision row for each of them. Either add them to priority (and the cut ladder) or document that they are opt-in via --arms.

+head/evals/suites/ablation-2.0.yaml:117 — The rules block comment still says "over 6 components printed"; the report quotes this block verbatim in its Method section while computing the sentence over 9 components, so the shipped report contradicts itself.

+head/evals/harness/validate-suite.sh:137 — TOGGLE_VALUES is a hand-maintained copy of the apply_arm_toggles vocabulary even though lib/sandbox-mount.sh is already sourced at line 92. Any toggle or value added to the library without updating this table is rejected as "unknown toggle" (and a stale entry here accepts a toggle the library no longer honours); derive the table from the library or add a test that asserts the two agree.

+head/evals/harness/pipeline-run.sh:341 — The dry-run `config_edits` re-implements the toggle→.loa.config.yaml key mapping of apply_arm_toggles in jq (companion_voice, gates, dissent, flatline). The new dry-run tests only check this mapping against itself and the stub mount library, so the plan line can silently drift from what the real library writes to the sandbox.

+head/evals/tests/run-ablation.bats:1196 — The PR title promises "the cycle-131 suite root (bounds 50/40) with its image self-check", but the diff touches nothing under grimoires/; this new smoke case and VS-1 depend on the committed suite root as-is and the smoke batch is launched without a prior `freeze.sh --smoke`, unlike RAB-4. Either the suite-root change is missing from the PR or the title/description overstates the scope.

Review written to `/workspace/review.md` with the verdict CHANGES_REQUIRED.

**What I found.** The wiring of the eval_only refusal itself is sound: pipeline-run.sh refuses before any run directory exists, run-ablation.sh sets the batch variable on the trial command only, and the validator's new schema checks are type-exact and tested. The defects are in how the four new arms flow into the report and the runner.

- **Decision logic is broken for review-catch-only arms.** The report's primaries lookup treats any arm with review-catch in its task types as needing the hidden-test pass rate too. The three new arms can never pair on that metric, so they always read inconclusive and can never reach remove or simplify. This is the blocking finding.
- **a0_bare_fable is counted as a component.** It is a bare baseline on the review model, yet it now receives keep/remove/simplify predicates against a1_full and inflates the expected-false-positive count.
- **The eval_only arm's rows vanish.** Rows for a1_full_openmount enter cells but appear in no decision, no per-arm detail and no "listed" section, so the open-mount A/B evidence is silently dropped.
- **Suite priority not extended.** Default batches never schedule the three new decision arms, while every report now prints a permanent "no rows" decision for them. The rules comment also still says six components and is quoted verbatim into the report.
- **Duplicated vocabularies.** The validator hand-copies the toggle vocabulary while already sourcing the library, and the dry-run plan re-implements the toggle-to-config mapping in jq. Both can drift and the tests only check them against the stub library.
- **Scope mismatch.** The title promises the cycle-131 suite root and image self-check, but nothing under grimoires/ is in the diff.

**Not verified.** The real mount library, took-effect.sh, the test fixture suites and the committed suite root are not in the PR, so I could not run the bats suites or confirm the new dry-run expectations (max_turns 170, timeout 4200) against the fixture suite's phase defaults.
